description_en: Releases a specified AgentTeams instance and cleans up related resources. Supports GET and POST methods. After a successful call, the instance status changes to DELETING, and resource cleanup is performed asynchronously in the background
description_zh: 用于释放指定的 AgentTeams 实例并清理相关资源。支持 GET 和 POST 方法，成功调用后实例状态将更改为 DELETING，资源清理由后台异步执行
name: DeleteInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentTeams instance to release
parameters.help_zh: 要释放的 AgentTeams 实例 ID
parameters.name: instance_id
